scope: Documented local platform workflow on iOS and Android with synthetic identities, free testing, development signing and provider protocol fixtures.

requirements.consoleBuildLogsAndArtifacts: Ordinary Chrome workflows ran real iOS and Android builds and displayed terminal logs. Both platforms downloaded all three native products with receipt-matched checksums.
requirements.nativeAndServiceOrchestration: Real Phoenix, PostgreSQL, restricted Oban and the Xcode or Linux Swift workers drove the selected work and released capacity once. Both platforms have live cancellation evidence.
requirements.developmentSigner: Separate development signing or attestation accepted the resulting native products after worker closure.
requirements.cliAndSignedDelivery: Stock CLI coverage includes upload, validation, publication, promotion, rollback and halt. Paired promotion and rollback retained exact replay behavior and signed known-good delivery after restart.
requirements.localRestore: A distinct SCRAM restore retained grants and signed delivery. Restricted release jobs produced matching projections for both targets.
requirements.storeProtocolFixtures: 34 compiled submission controls and 25 status controls cover App Store Connect, TestFlight and Google Play requests, outcomes and failure handling.
requirements.freePrivateExecution: The fixtures used local services and synthetic identities without payment configuration. The rendered Android capacity ledger released once and billing snapshots matched.

independentReview.determination: L05 passes for the documented local platform workflow.
independentReview.readback: Recomputed the Android receipt hash, matched four executed fixture sources and seven fixture inventory paths against Git, and traced the exact single build to both rendered log events and three matching artifact hashes.
independentReview.iosSourceContinuity: The v85 iOS event, artifact limits and console readback semantics are retained across Android extensions. The later stock attestation run exercised revised real iOS build and authenticated artifact paths.
independentReview.runScope: The review independently checked tracked source and recorded observations. The underlying build outputs and Chrome download files were removed in the original owned cleanup.

historicalExceptions: The supplemental iOS post-exit 503 occurred after the completed build and downloads. The maintained former-owner replay verified the expected 401 and 404. The Android preview timed out twice before dispatch and the disposable Chrome run passed.
laterQualification: Actual store submissions and processing, production providers and deployments, and launch qualification remain in their later gates.
